trovato: The S&P 500 dropped 2% for a sixth straight loss. That's its longest losing streak since 2024, and it's down 8.2% from its record set last month. The losses were widespread, and more than 90% of the stocks that make up the S&P 500 fell. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 1,101.11 points, or 2.2%, to 49,097.06.
